theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_phi_bound
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid N') (k + 1)) (D : Euclid (N + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (φ : Covector (Euclid N) k) (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ b → ‖D (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)‖ ≤ a → (∀ v : Euclid N, ‖D (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)))‖ ≤ b * ‖v‖) → (∀ v : Fin k → Euclid N, φ v = (γ.compContinuousLinearMap D) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → covectorEuclideanNorm φ ≤ b ^ k * a * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
